print("custody:", " -> ".join(chain), "| complete:", complete)

title: Signature: Backup expiry tracker
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): backups inherit deletion obligations: when source data must be deleted, every backup containing it is tracked to expiry. The tracker lists which backups hold the data and when each ages out. Deletion is not done until backups are clean. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers backups inheriting deletion obligations.

CFG = {1: [30, 60], 2: [30, 60, 90], 3: [7, 30, 60, 90]}
expiries = CFG[LEVEL]
pending = [e for e in expiries if e > 0]
print("backups holding data:", expiries, "| pending expiry:", pending or ["none - deletion complete"])
